title: 쌍자음 쓰기: ㄲ ㄸ ㅃ ㅆ ㅉ
objective: Write ㄲ ㄸ ㅃ ㅆ ㅉ and read easy words with them.
summary: Learn to write the five Korean double consonants and say their tight sounds.

task.title: Read, build and write
task.line: Use the letter table and word list to answer each small question.

words.exampleMeaning: Can you see the fox's tail over there?

letters.as: Like k, t, p in 'skin, stop, spin': tight, no puff of air.
A sharp, tense 's', like the 'ss' in 'hiss'.
A tight 'j' with no puff of air, like a tense 'j'/'ch' sound with the tongue pressed firmly; English has no exact match.

exercises: Which double consonant is in each word? ① 오빠 ② 이따가 ③ 가짜
Put the letters together into one syllable block: ① ㄲ + ㅗ ② ㅆ + ㅏ ③ ㅃ + ㅜ
Fill in the blank to match the romanization: ① 아__ (akka) ② __리 (ppuri) ③ 머리__ (meoritti)
Choose the word that matches the romanization: ① ssayo — 사요 / 싸요 ② jayo — 자요 / 짜요 ③ ppuri — 부리 / 뿌리
answers: ① ㅃ ② ㄸ ③ ㅉ
① 꼬 ② 싸 ③ 뿌
① 까 ② 뿌 ③ 띠
① 싸요 ② 자요 ③ 뿌리
